$comment: Real jobs: tasks a person does with this app, each with an outcome a check can observe. Keyed by job id so scripts/merge-json merges two PRs that add different jobs. scripts/jobs check validates every field; jobs.md beside this file is generated from it on dev (scripts/jobs render), never edited. The fields and the done rule: docs/factory/packets.md, Jobs.

RJ-P01.job: Crop a 6000×4000 JPEG to 1080×1350 for Instagram and export JPEG.
RJ-P01.outcome: Output is exactly 1080×1350, the subject stays where it was framed, nothing is squashed.
RJ-P01.needs_note: photo/photo-crop (built), S11 export at a size
RJ-P01.trap: No 4:5 chip (chips are Free, Original, 1:1, 3:2, 4:3, 16:9), so it takes a typed ratio, then Image Size, then Export: two resamples and an easy 1349 px or squash

RJ-P02.job: Add a bold title ("SUMMER SALE", heavy weight, 120 pt, centred) over a photo and export.
RJ-P02.outcome: Text is crisp, centred, and still editable after save and reopen.
RJ-P02.trap: Text rasterised on save, or the font silently swapped on reopen

RJ-P03.job: Add a Curves adjustment layer (S-curve), hide and show it, save, reopen.
RJ-P03.outcome: The curve is still a live layer and the pixels underneath are untouched.
RJ-P03.trap: Adjustment baked into pixels on save; one curve drag making 40 undo steps

RJ-P04.job: Remove 20 sensor dust spots from a sky, one click each.
RJ-P04.outcome: No halo, no tone shift, no repeated texture.
RJ-P04.trap: Today's Heal is a per-dab tone match: grain and gradient smear show at 100%

RJ-P05.job: Blend two photos with a soft-brush layer mask.
RJ-P05.outcome: The seam is invisible, the mask stays editable, and it survives save and reopen.
RJ-P05.trap: Mask flattened on save; brush on mask paints colour instead of grey

RJ-P06.job: Select Subject on a portrait, then copy the person to a new layer.
RJ-P06.outcome: Hair edges are clean and it works offline.
RJ-P06.trap: Halo around hair; a silent network call for the model

RJ-P07.job: Remove a passer-by from a beach photo (lasso, then Remove).
RJ-P07.outcome: The fill matches sand and sea with no cloned copies.
RJ-P07.trap: Repeated-pattern fill; works on a 50 px spot but not a person-sized area

RJ-P08.job: Resize a folder of 50 JPEGs to a 2048 px long edge and stamp a PNG logo bottom-right.
RJ-P08.outcome: Originals untouched, logo the same relative size on portrait and landscape.
RJ-P08.needs_note: none: batch is a Photo non-goal; Library export has no watermark
RJ-P08.trap: Originals overwritten; watermark scaled by pixels, not by long edge; metadata kept

RJ-P09.job: Open a 20-layer PSD (groups, masks, a text layer, adjustment layers), edit, save as PSD, reopen in another editor.
RJ-P09.outcome: Layers, groups, masks and blend modes are intact; anything dropped is named before saving.
RJ-P09.trap: Groups flattened or text rasterised without a warning

RJ-P10.job: Extend the canvas 20% and fill the new area from a prompt.
RJ-P10.outcome: The fill matches the scene; nothing is sent anywhere without asking.
RJ-P10.needs_note: AI via Paw OS (not in the beta-80 plan by design)
RJ-P10.trap: The image leaves the Mac without a consent step

RJ-P11.job: Export a GPS-tagged phone photo as JPEG with no metadata.
RJ-P11.outcome: The file has no GPS, no camera serial, no MakerNote, and it is still upright.
RJ-P11.trap: Pass today by construction (ImageIOCodec writes pixels and quality only) but no test holds it; a later 'keep metadata' option that copies source properties would bring GPS back

RJ-P12.job: Fix a tungsten-orange photo with White Balance (temperature and tint).
RJ-P12.trap: Only the whole image, not as an adjustment layer

RJ-P13.job: Rescue a backlit portrait with Shadows/Highlights and Contrast.
RJ-P13.outcome: The face lifts, the sky keeps detail.

RJ-P14.job: Sharpen a photo for web after downsizing (Unsharp Mask).
RJ-P14.outcome: Edges are crisp with no bright halos at the default amount.

RJ-P15.job: Straighten a tilted horizon by drawing along it.
RJ-P15.outcome: The horizon is level and there are no transparent corner wedges.

RJ-P16.job: Cut out a product and put it on pure white with Remove Background.
RJ-P16.outcome: The edge has no fringe of the old colour.

RJ-P17.job: Paste a logo and scale it from a corner, rotate it 15°, flip it.
RJ-P17.outcome: It keeps its aspect and stays sharp.
RJ-P17.needs_note: S7 transform; photo/transform wires it into Photo
RJ-P17.trap: Aspect squash on a corner drag; repeated scaling blurs it

RJ-P18.job: Add a 200 px white border with Canvas Size.
RJ-P18.outcome: The image is centred and the new area is white.
RJ-P18.needs_note: S7 Canvas Size on E5's pad (done); photo/transform wires it
RJ-P18.trap: New area transparent, or the image shifted by a pixel

RJ-P19.job: Fill a selection with a sky gradient.
RJ-P19.outcome: Smooth, no banding, stays inside the selection.
RJ-P19.needs_note: E6's raster gradient (on the pinned core); photo/gradient-fill adds the Gradient tool
RJ-P19.trap: Solid fill works; no gradient tool; banding in 8-bit

RJ-P20.job: Clone a power line out of a sky.
RJ-P20.outcome: No visible repeat, one undo step per stroke.
RJ-P20.trap: One stroke recorded as many undo steps

RJ-P21.job: Paint with a pen tablet at 16 px.
RJ-P21.outcome: Pressure changes width and the brush circle shows where it will paint.
RJ-P21.needs_note: v1 Brush (built); brush cursor via adopt-kernel-brush

RJ-P22.job: Pick a colour from the photo with the eyedropper for a title.
RJ-P22.trap: Picks the screen colour, not the document's

RJ-P23.job: Duplicate, rename, reorder, merge down and flatten layers.
RJ-P23.outcome: The composite looks the same after each step.
RJ-P23.trap: Merge down changes the look of a blended layer

RJ-P24.job: Put a paper texture on Multiply at 60% opacity.
RJ-P24.outcome: Matches the blend preview after export.
RJ-P24.trap: Export composites differently from the canvas

RJ-P25.job: Open a 100 MP image (12000×8000), zoom to 100%, pan, paint a stroke.
RJ-P25.outcome: No stall over 100 ms; memory stays under the gate's budget.
RJ-P25.trap: Untested at 100 MP; undo of a big stroke may copy the whole layer

RJ-P26.outcome: Photo offers to restore with every layer.
RJ-P26.trap: Restore loses the mask or the adjustment layer

RJ-P27.job: Do 50 mixed steps (crop, curves, brush, merge), then undo all.
RJ-P27.outcome: Pixels and canvas size match the original exactly.
RJ-P27.trap: Undo Crop restores the wrong canvas size

RJ-P28.job: Jump back 10 steps by clicking the History panel.
RJ-P28.outcome: One click goes back 10 steps, and the canvas, the History panel and the Edit menu's Undo item agree.

RJ-P29.job: Export a cut-out as PNG and as JPEG.
RJ-P29.outcome: The PNG keeps transparency; the JPEG puts it on white, not black.
RJ-P29.trap: JPEG encode uses noneSkipLast on straight RGBA, so clear pixels may come out black: verify

RJ-P30.job: Export WebP, HEIC and TIFF for a client.
RJ-P30.outcome: Each opens in Preview at the right size.
RJ-P30.trap: Format offered but writes PNG bytes

RJ-P31.job: Open a Display P3 iPhone photo, edit, export.
RJ-P31.outcome: Colours match on a P3 screen and an sRGB profile is embedded.
RJ-P31.trap: Decode draws into 8-bit sRGB: P3 reds clip

RJ-P32.job: Apply strong Curves to a 16-bit TIFF sky.

RJ-P33.job: Drag guides to the thirds and snap a layer to them.
RJ-P33.outcome: The guides sit at one third and two thirds, and the layer's edge snaps onto them.

RJ-P35.job: Paste a screenshot from the clipboard as a layer, then copy the result into Messages.
RJ-P35.trap: Pasteboard copy carries the source's metadata

RJ-P36.job: Sample a 5 x 5 mean by command on a red and blue checkerboard, and a point outside the image.
RJ-P36.outcome: The centred 5 x 5 square reads the 13-red, 12-blue mix within 1 per channel, and the outside point reads null.
RJ-P36.trap: The sample reads the active layer, or the square is anchored at its corner

RJ-P37.job: Place a PNG logo onto an open 800 x 600 image and save the flattened result.
RJ-P37.outcome: The output is 800 x 600 with the 200 x 100 logo centred (its red half at x 350, its blue half at x 450) on a new layer, and the canvas around it unchanged.
RJ-P37.trap: The place opens the logo as a new document, or lands it at the top-left corner

RJ-P42.job: Drop a PNG from Finder onto an open image.
RJ-P42.outcome: It becomes one centred layer named after the file in one undo step; undo removes it.
RJ-P42.trap: The drop replaces the document or opens a second window, or takes two undo steps

RJ-P43.job: Select three layers, fade them to 50% opacity and nudge them 40 px right together.
RJ-P43.outcome: All three layers are at 50% and 40 px right in the export; the fourth layer is unchanged.
RJ-P43.needs_note: photo/multi-layer-select puts Photo's layer selection on the kernel Selection and applies layer actions to every selected layer

RJ-P44.job: Outline a cut-out with a 4 px white stroke and a soft drop shadow, save, reopen and fade the shadow.
RJ-P44.outcome: After reopening, the layer's style still lists the stroke and the shadow; the exported PNG has a white ring 4 px outside the shape and the shadow at the new opacity, with the shape's own pixels unchanged.
RJ-P44.trap: The style is flattened into the pixels on save, or the stroke lands inside the shape

RJ-P45.job: Clip a texture layer to the shape below it, then try to clip the bottom layer.
RJ-P45.outcome: The texture shows only inside the shape's alpha; clipping the bottom layer is refused with a reason.
RJ-P45.trap: The clip uses the base's bounding box instead of its alpha, or a clip with nothing below succeeds silently

RJ-P46.job: Open a PSD whose badge has a drop shadow and a stroke effect, change the shadow's distance, and export a PNG.
RJ-P46.outcome: The badge opens with an editable style holding exactly the drop shadow and the stroke; after the edit the shadow sits at the new distance along the PSD's angle within 1 px.
RJ-P46.trap: The effects open flattened into pixels, or vanish with no warning

RJ-P70.job: Flip a two-layer image horizontally with Flip Canvas and export PNG.
RJ-P70.outcome: The PNG equals the original mirrored, pixel for pixel.
RJ-P70.trap: Only the selected layer flips, or the top layer keeps its old offset

RJ-P71.job: Make a new 4x6 in image at 300 ppi with a transparent background, draw a red square, and export PNG.
RJ-P71.outcome: The PNG is 1200x1800, its corner alpha is 0, and its pHYs says 300 ppi.
RJ-P71.trap: The image comes out 1920x1080 white, or 4x6 px

RJ-P50.job: Blur only the top half of a portrait: select it and run Gaussian Blur at radius 8.
RJ-P50.outcome: Every pixel of the bottom half equals the input byte for byte; the top half's local variance drops by more than half.
RJ-P50.trap: The blur leaks past the selection edge or runs on the whole image

RJ-P51.job: Fill a logo's white background with red using the paint bucket (tolerance 32, contiguous) and export.
RJ-P51.outcome: Every background pixel is red; every logo pixel, edges included, is unchanged.
RJ-P51.trap: The fill bleeds into the anti-aliased logo edge or misses the corners
